content.short: PawnSpace is a decentralized NFT-collateral lending platform across multiple chains using a peer-to-peer lending model.
content.description: PawnSpace is a decentralized NFT-collateral lending platform that relies on a peer-to-peer model. It lets users collateralize ERC-721 NFTs and enables borrowers and lenders to handpick deals based on the collateral's value, terms, and risk preferences. Loans are arranged directly between participants, with no centralized intermediary in charge of the agreement. The platform operates across Polygon, Base, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain, enabling asset-backed borrowing and lending in a multi-chain environment.
